objective: The owner's question of 2026-11-25 (sub-goal B329; assumptions A228, A229 and A223; goals G5 with G15 and G18): "Is time itself a fold like intelligence/life through DNA?", and his request the same day that the research be taken on. Three things are kept apart: an order (a knot comes after its parents), which is not a pattern; a clock (a pattern that returns), which takes nothing in; and time as it is told, one pattern counting another's returns, which has the form of his fold of emergence. The question: under the cheapest law of the study of parts that meet again, with both of its rations, is there a pattern the growth makes whose births follow another pattern's returns and cease when that pattern is stopped? First step: a census of which patterns still return at all under the laws that let parts meet, on the starts of the ring that returns and of the parts that meet again; then, where one returns, the paired test on each second part, with the first there and with the first stopped. Stop at one made part whose births follow another's returns at a fixed ratio over at least four returns and cease when the other is stopped, with the reader and the law's choice said plainly to be supplied or made; or at a reason no law of that kind holds both a pattern that returns and one that meets it at each return. Standard: the claim stated before it is tested; a frozen pre-registration reviewed cold by the advisor; an engine written from the frozen text; the knot test on every knot made under parity and not-all-equal; every added rule named as a scaffold and swapped; no claims about physical time, living things or minds; every new word checked with the advisor.
status: Complete 2026-11-25 (partially successful; referee pending): no pattern the growth makes counts another pattern's returns under any law run (88,299 tests, each decided); under the two cheapest laws that let parts meet no clock gives parts off at four ticks; a second part's course follows a clock at each of three returns only under rules that choose by name, each case lost under some renumbering. Neither side of the filed stop is reached, and about half of the main run was not run. STOP on this objective; the missing precondition (a law that keeps a clock while a second part's growth is bounded) is filed as a sub-goal.
title: Time as a fold: a made pattern that counts another pattern's returns
